# CallVault

> CallVault is a personal Android call-recording app. It records the owner's own
> phone calls, keeps them offline-first on the device (Drift/SQLite is the source of
> truth), and optionally backs the audio up to storage the owner controls. It is not
> on Google Play (Play bans silent call recorders) — it is a signed APK you sideload.
> A web dashboard built from the same codebase lets you browse backed-up recordings.
> No third-party analytics or telemetry: your-server-only.

Note: Google's docs state it ignores llms.txt. This file is here for other AI
engines and agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) that do read it.
